reasoning: The federal list explicitly preserves the prior Fort Sill Apache Tribe of Oklahoma label. Its corresponding BIA Tribe record has the expanded Fort Sill-Chiricahua-Warm Springs-Apache name and points to fortsillapache-nsn.gov, exactly the registry profile official domain. That nation-owned government page identifies the Fort Sill Apache Tribe General Council and Business Committee. The different published and self-used name styles refer to the same specified governing body.
limitations: This does not identify every Chiricahua community or governing body across the United States and Mexico.
Fort Sill, Mescalero and the broader Chiricahua people remain distinct research subjects.
The broader identity-chiricahua-contemporary-bodies task stays pending.
